fast.$description: Tanggap, mikro, elastis (tactile feedback). Target Tailwind: duration-150. Hover & active state tombol, pemulihan cincin fokus, centang checkbox, dan toggle switch.

normal.$description: Seimbang, lincah (component transition). Target Tailwind: duration-200. Elevasi kartu linimasa (card hover), buka/tutup menu dropdown, kemunculan tooltip, dan tab filter.

moderate.$description: Halus, struktural (layout & flow shift). Target Tailwind: duration-250. Pergeseran blok jadwal otomatis (ripple reschedule), reposisi kartu linimasa, indikator geser tab.

slow.$description: Terarah, berbobot (surface & modal overlay). Target Tailwind: duration-300. Dialog Adaptive Reschedule Modal, lembar geser Bottom Sheet seluler, dan pemudaran lapisan gelap Backdrop Scrim.

deliberate.$description: Bertahap, ekspansif (data expansion & alert). Target Tailwind: duration-400. Buka/tutup vertikal detail tugas (accordion expand), pengisian bilah kapasitas (capacity meter fill), System Banner.

fluid.$description: Fluid Ease (Default) - Digunakan untuk transisi umum dua arah, perubahan warna/border, dan hover.

decelerate.$description: Decelerate / Enter Ease - Digunakan saat elemen baru memasuki layar (entry) agar mendarat secara tenang.

accelerate.$description: Accelerate / Exit Ease - Digunakan saat elemen keluar atau menghilang dari layar (exit/dismiss).
